title: Extract the order in force after a revision
levels: Every field matches the source and the schema exactly
At least one field is missing, extra, of the wrong type or different from the source

cases.rationale: It extracts the cancelled original, with order_number "4471" and total_minor 29760, where the order in force is "4471-R2" with a total of 11070 yen.
It records order 4471-R2 with its two lines, the total of 24 x 380 plus 3 x 650, so 11070, and replaces "4471".
All eight fields match the updated order, item order included; only the key order and whitespace differ.
items[0].quantity is 12, the steel bracket count from the cancelled original, where the updated order has 24.
